entries.7e0a1676d787be3f: In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the Sensor Division grew on strong sales to the domestic chemical industry, a recovery in sales to the semiconductor industry and strong sales to the shipbuilding-related industry in China, and the Service Division also remained firm on sales to the chemical and petroleum industries. entries.ba6fb1f44b0259c8: Since its founding in 1949, it has accumulated fluid measurement technology and has a structure in which the group handles everything from manufacturing flow meters to calibration and maintenance. In the decarbonization field, it offers flow meters for hydrogen and ammonia measurement, and it is advancing measurement and calibration for hydrogen supply chains, including opening the facility 'OVAL H2 Lab' in February 2026 to calibrate flow meters with actual hydrogen gas.

entries.f99010bce4d691a2: The company is headquartered in Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo, and operates together with 12 consolidated subsidiaries and 3 affiliates. Consolidated number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 678.
entries.f9b28fbc62746ac5: Its medium-to-long-term management vision is to become “Asia's No.1 Sensing Solution Company,” and from the fiscal year ended March 2026 it has launched Medium-Term Management Plan PHASE2 “Imagination2028.” As growth strategies it has set out growth strategies for the sensor, service and system businesses and a new business creation strategy, and as management base strengthening strategies, productivity improvement, personnel and finance reinforcement, DX promotion and sustainability promotion, and it states that it aims to transform existing businesses and realize innovation.
